supporting_observations.claim: During the alert window, WS-TWEBER-01 (10.51.10.22) made repeated outbound TCP connections to PROXY-PIN-01 (10.51.20.30) on port 8080. Examples occur at 13:36, 13:41, 13:45–13:46, 13:51–13:52, 13:55, 14:01, and 14:06 UTC.

Several of those proxy sessions have similar traffic volumes, around 6.9 KB sent and 30 KB received, and recur at roughly several-minute intervals. This is consistent with periodic web activity, but does not identify its purpose.
The supplied records establish connections to the internal proxy on port 8080, but do not establish that these sessions were direct outbound HTTPS connections or identify their external destination.

known_telemetry_limitations: The available WS-TWEBER-01 network records show connections to the proxy on port 8080, but provide no proxy request logs, URL or hostname, or other destination details for those sessions (for example, records T075-00161 and T075-00177).
The supplied records do not attribute the proxy sessions to a process or user, so they cannot confirm whether they came from the approved MediLedger updater or another application.
claims_not_established: Whether the recurring proxy sessions accessed update.medledger.com or another destination.
Whether the sessions were encrypted HTTPS requests carried through the proxy.
Whether the activity was generated by approved software or by malicious code.
Whether any data in the sessions was malicious or sensitive.
additional_evidence_needed: PROXY-PIN-01 access logs for WS-TWEBER-01 covering 13:20–14:20 UTC, including requested hostnames or URLs, methods, status codes, and byte counts.
Endpoint process and network telemetry for WS-TWEBER-01 during the same interval to identify the process and user responsible for the proxy connections.
MediLedger updater and system logs, including evidence of scheduled update checks around the observed times.
unrelated_findings: Separate review: WS-ARUIZ-01 made TLS connections to WS-TWEBER-01 on port 443; the supplied records identify the TLS server name but not the purpose or application (T075-00037, T075-00038, T075-00039, T075-00072, T075-00073, T075-00074, T075-00075, T075-00076, T075-00077, T075-00080, T075-00081, T075-00082, T075-00141, T075-00142, T075-00143).

Separate review: WS-RPATEL-01 and WS-ESTONE-01 also made TLS connections to WS-TWEBER-01 on port 443; these connections are not the alerted outbound proxy activity (T075-00185, T075-00186, T075-00187, T075-00199, T075-00200, T075-00201).
Separate review: PROXY-PIN-01 initiated a TCP connection to WS-TWEBER-01 on port 135 at 14:07 UTC (T075-00195, T075-00198).
